source_data_attestation: Original provider UUID, file byte count and MD5 MUST be exactly equal to metadata receipt, and checksum downloaded source bytes verified BEFORE any GPS rows are parsed.
q: Within original registered tag/year use existing RSDS one_taxon: at most one original fix per UTC-hour, adjacent accepted segments 0.5–2h, speed<=60 km/h, same local solar daypart/date at start/midpoint/end. Require >=3 eligible DAY and >=3 eligible NIGHT step segments in date and >=10 qualified dates per animal-year. q = log1p median NIGHT straight-line GPS speed minus log1p median DAY GPS speed. Equal supported original tagged animal means, not latent activity time.
daylight: Use pre-existing within-animal-year q~astronomical daylength slope, independent distinct observational estimand; only if >=5 original tagged animal slopes available
native: All source-registered species labels retained; sample of taxa cannot be selected by positive or significant q effects. For native effects require >=5 original tagged animals, and preserve q/daylength unavailable explicitly as null. Entire original metadata-selected study source remains original unit.
multi_joint: For all originally registered multi-native source taxa, only when every native has >=5 qualified tagged animals and all share >=40 common dates / >=5 valid year-month blocks, calculate separate date-equal q and month-centered slope 1000-replicate covariance using original source month block and positive animal bootstrap. No borrowing from previous source PR #24.
privacy: Homo sapiens source index 10 is a human-location privacy HOLD: do not request original files, MD5, GPS or location data at ANY later stage. No original GPS animal IDs/coordinates/exact dates, tracks or individual effects leave ephemeral CI. Pet cat and pigeon source estimates must remain group-level and not expose owner/home locations.
no_source_resampling: Every first-wave or second-wave selected source stays in original 16+19 denominator regardless of scientific HOLD or biological effect sign. Source-wide GPS exceptions void partial native data, without replacing source.
selected_population: 35 of 120 fixed 2026-10-19 repository metadata candidates, not a global wildlife random sampling frame; wave2 quotas were chosen after wave1 outcome but source ID rank is original SHA order.
